description: Potentiele locaties voor windenergie 200 meters AN0 is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. This map shows potential locations where wind turbines with a tip height of 200 meters could be placed. It is the contramal of all legal and physical exclusion areas. The distance standard set out in the draft Wind Turbine Provisions Decree (2x the tip height) has been taken into account. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Potential locations for wind energy 200 meters AN0" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
